summary: The message to delete could not be resolved.

match_any.description_exact: Bad Request: message to delete not found

possible_causes: The message identifier is missing or nonpositive.
The bot cannot access messages in the chat.
A message lookup failed and its original error was replaced.
diagnostic_limits: The response does not distinguish a deleted message from an incorrect identifier, missing access or a masked lookup error. Batch deletion can skip missing messages; this response is not an inventory of deleted items.

evidence.note: Deleting the test bot’s own message again after confirmed deletion returned this description.
Single and batch deletion use "message to delete"; the batch path permits missing items.
Missing identifiers and unavailable message access produce this operation-specific fallback.
Failed lookups use the same fallback when an empty result is not allowed.
The fallback replaces only errors normalized to code 400.
Adds the code-specific prefix and lowercases only the initial character of ordinary messages.

response.description: Bad Request: message to delete not found

preconditions: Check the chat and message identifiers together, then confirm the bot can access the target message.
